item.title: Bradley outlasts Valpo in 2OT in MVC Tournament
item.description: ST. LOUIS (WMBD/WYZZ) -- Bradley is advancing to the semifinals of the Missouri Valley Conference Tournament after a double overtime thriller. Jaquan Johnson scored 18 as did Ahmet Jonovic as Bradley outlasted Valparaiso, 90-84, in an MVC quarterfinal at Enterprise Center. item.title: Peoria apartment fire contained; lightning may be cause
item.description: A fire at a North Peoria apartment building caused by a lightning strike during a storm caused $250,000 in damage, displaced two people, and was contained within 20 minutes with no injuries reported.

item.title: METEC Resource Center reports financial irregularities to police
item.description: Peoria police are investigating after a local non-profit, METEC Resource Center, reported financial irregularities caused by a previous employee.

item.title: Central Illinois receives 1-3 inches of rain, drought persists
item.description: Central Illinois received 1-5 inches of rain this week, helping to alleviate the severe to extreme drought, but more rain is needed to end it.

item.title: East Peoria Kick-a-thon raises money for Children’s Home Association of Illinois
item.description: Farrell's Extreme Bodyshaping in East Peoria hosted its third annual Kick-a-thon to raise money for the Children's Home Association of Illinois, raising over $1,500 in donations.

item.title: Tremont fishing fundraiser reels in support for St. Jude
item.description: The 5th Annual Fishing for a Cure Fishing Show and Tackle Swap, organized by the Tremont High School fishing team, raised money for St. Jude Children's Research Hospital with over 100 vendor tables, seminars, and raffles.

item.title: Bloomington firefighters successfully contain downtown warehouse fire
item.description: The Bloomington Fire Department contained a warehouse fire in the 400 block of Madison Street on Saturday, with no injuries reported and the cause of the fire under investigation.

item.title: 11-year-old girl injured in UTV crash in Chillicothe
item.description: An 11-year-old girl was seriously injured after a UTV crash in Chillicothe Friday night, and the driver was issued several tickets.

item.title: Dee-Mack girls basketball wins first ever state championship
item.description: The Deer Creek-Mackinaw Chiefs girls basketball team won the IHSA Class 1A State Championship for the first time in school history, led by senior Dalia DeJesus' double-double.

item.title: Washington Panthers girls basketball win first ever state championship
item.description: The Washington Panthers girls basketball team won the IHSA Class 3A championship, defeating the Glenwood Titans 33-2 to become state champs for the first time in program history.
